_nav_breakpoint_comment: SHELL.md r6/r11: the breakpoint belongs to the surface and is BISECTED, never computed. RE-BISECTED 2026-09-05 (second time that day) in Chromium via agent-browser set viewport, with the stacking rule overridden in the page so the unstacked nav could be measured by link centres: with the six-item nav (What it is · How it works · Worlds · Evidence · Correct us · Source) the unstacked nav is two rows at 688px and one row from 689px, so the header stacks at 720px, 31px before the wrap. Earlier the same day the five-item nav wrapped at 552 and stacked at 580; the original nav wrapped at 576 and stacked at 600. ANY CHANGE TO A NAV LABEL INVALIDATES THIS NUMBER AND IT MUST BE RE-BISECTED — the gate binds the labels to this record and stops the build when they differ.
_ink_box_comment: SHELL.md r7, second item: a line-height set against the em size can be smaller than the font's actual ink, and consecutive lines then overlap — agentromatic's Syne h1 overlapped by 11.8px and a descender collided with the cap-height beneath it. MEASURED here rather than assumed, 2026-08-17 in Chrome at 1280, by rendering each element's own text in its own computed font to a canvas and comparing actualBoundingBoxAscent+actualBoundingBoxDescent against the computed line box. Space Grotesk 600 at 57.6px inks 51.0px inside a 60.5px box. Every value above is headroom in pixels and every one is positive, so nothing here needed changing. Re-measured at 390/700/1280/1600 for the h1: +4.1 / +5.2 / +9.5 / +9.5. THE PUBLICATION GATE CANNOT CHECK THIS — it has no font engine and no browser — so it is a recorded measurement, not an enforced law, and it is said that way on purpose.

surface_rung_covers: the graphonomous/v2 lane in the repository — its adapters, projector, WRL world builder and TRVM certificate, its sealed projections, and its test suite run on this machine. Nothing from it has been published anywhere
definition: Graphonomous is an autonomous semantic/evidence graph that continuously constructs, tests, relates and explains a model of what a system understands.
boundary: It is downstream of authority by design. It observes, relates, derives, diagnoses, ranks and proposes; the registry, factory or adjudication that owns a fact decides whether a proposal becomes canonical. It never silently decides truth and never becomes another authority.

status.statement: The lane at v2/ in the repository passes [[tests_pass]] of [[tests_total]] tests, with [[tests_skipped]] skipped by design; it seals [[worlds_sealed]] projections as WallRiderLang worlds, derives [[derived_facts]] facts under [[rules]] rules on the largest of them, and finds cross-registry inconsistencies with [[consistency_rules]] rules. Nothing from it is in any published package.
status.source: npm run test:full-tree in graphonomous/v2 at the commit witness.json names, against sibling checkouts pinned by commit; g0 verify, verify-eval, check-cert and consistency over every shipped projection in the same run. Every figure on this page is emitted from records/witness.json, and check.mjs re-derives each derivable one from the lane and from WRL's own module.
status.limit: Everything above was run on one machine, by the people who wrote it, against registries they also maintain. Nothing here establishes that anyone else has reproduced the [[tests_total]] tests, that the graph is useful rather than merely sound, or that a reader can install anything — there is no published artifact, and the package under this name on the npm registry is an earlier engine this page does not describe. The demo on this domain was generated from the same tree and is not independent evidence.

advance.requires: A packaged lane a reader can run locally — a released bundle that carries the pinned registries it needs — and then the same verdict, [[tests_pass]] of [[tests_total]], from a machine that is not this one.

pipeline.title: Pin
pipeline.what: A snapshot names every repository it reads by commit, tree and blob — [[pinned_sources]] of them for the largest one, Super (CD) at [[super_pin]] among them. A blob that has moved is refused, never re-read. Reading Super's evidence is the first half of a loop whose second half — Super carrying Graphonomous as every agent's memory — is designed and not built.

pipeline.title: Ingest
pipeline.what: [[adapters]] adapters read those bytes and emit nodes, relations, assertions and source locations. What an adapter cannot normalize becomes a typed fault beside the records — [[faults]] of them in the largest projection — not a guess.

pipeline.title: Project
pipeline.what: The records fold into one content-addressed root. Shuffle the inputs, reverse the adapters, build again: the same root, and a Python twin re-derives it from the manifest alone.
pipeline.refusal: a root that does not re-derive

pipeline.title: Seal
pipeline.what: The semantic world is submitted to WallRiderLang as a Semantic IR 2.0 artifact under a profile Graphonomous declared as data — [[roles]] roles, [[kinds]] kinds, [[pairs]] admissible pairs. WRL's kernel mints the world id and every relation and revision id. Graphonomous submits; it never mints.

pipeline.title: Certify
pipeline.what: A certificate is minted through TRVM over the claim, its aggregate and the chain of code identities that produced it. It says under which verifier coordinates the projection reconstructs — never that it is "still valid".

pipeline.title: Check
pipeline.what: A checker re-derives every plane from the directory and writes nothing. Across families, a consistency pass names what two normalized sources disagree about — [[findings]] findings on the largest world, the sharpest being one file read at two different blobs.

stack._comment: The stack in one sentence per part. Pressable on the page; the sentences are the record's, the links are the surfaces' own.

parent.label: ComputeDriven
parent.line: the world these three run in: an operating system whose backup is the user's machine, and the compute surface above it

parts.label: WRL
parts.line: WallRiderLang describes understanding. A world is a content-addressed description; a vocabulary is a profile row; meaning is a hash.

parts.label: TRVM
parts.line: TRVM reduces and derives understanding. It is the execution and reduction engine, and it mints the certificates Graphonomous carries.

parts.label: Graphonomous
parts.line: Graphonomous stores, connects, explores, tests and evolves understanding: the semantic self-model of a ComputeDriven system, read from the registries that hold its truth.

around.label: Super (CD)
around.line: Super is the operating environment around all of this — the surface that lets humans and artificial beings actually use it. Its blueprint gives every agent a memory that survives an engine swap, and Graphonomous is what is meant to fill that slot. Today Graphonomous reads Super's evidence at a pinned commit; the rest is designed and not built.

shape._comment: Compiler-shaped, but the thing compiled is understanding. Rows align: a compiler stage on the left, the Graphonomous stage on the right, and whether the right-hand one exists.

rows.ours: the owning registry admits, or refuses

shape.input: what the system currently knows · where that knowledge came from · what depends on what · what contradicts what · what observations support it · what would falsify it · what simpler explanation could replace it

loop._comment: The understanding loop the lane is heading toward, one stage per entry, each marked by what exists in the tree today. built = TESTED in handoff/STATUS.md; designed = in the brief or the decision log and not yet code.

stages.label: observation
stages.what: adapters read [[pinned_sources]] pinned repositories and emit records

stages.label: evidence
stages.what: every claim carries its assertion, its registry and a source location; provenance lives on the assertion, never in the value

stages.label: semantic structure
stages.what: the projection root, and the WRL-sealed world with kernel-minted ids

stages.label: dependency
stages.what: [[rules]] rules derive [[derived_facts]] facts over the largest world's records, with an independent checker that shares no logic with the evaluator

stages.label: contradiction
stages.what: [[consistency_rules]] cross-registry rules find what two normalized sources disagree about; [[consistency_rejected]] candidate rules reduced to zero and were not implemented

stages.label: hypothesis
stages.what: a candidate law or explanation, proposed by the graph and owned by nobody until admitted

stages.label: counterexample
stages.what: the observation that would falsify a hypothesis, named before it is looked for

stages.label: experiment
stages.what: the invariant factory runs it; receipts come back; the graph re-imports what was admitted

stages.label: reduction
stages.what: the smallest explanatory structure that preserves the observations: what a compiler calls optimization, a database normalization, a prover derivation and a scientist a theory

overlap._comment: Positioning, not a measurement: how much Graphonomous overlaps with an existing category (dots out of five, an opinion) and why it goes past it. Rendered under a dashed tag for exactly that reason.

rows.beyond: relationships are semantic and evidential rather than stored records

evidence and law reduction starts approaching this territory

actual execution stays elsewhere, in TRVM
dependency and derivation relationships resemble builds
experiments, counterexamples, evidence and provenance matter
